newsitem.title: USA: Clinton jokes about knee, flatters Bush, Ford.
newsitem.headline: Clinton jokes about knee, flatters Bush, Ford.

text.p: Sharing the limelight is not easy at the best of times, and harder still when the people on stage with you are two presidents.

But President Clinton managed to coax a smile out of former Presidents George Bush and Gerald Ford at a luncheon Monday by jokingly referring to the knee injury that has kept him on crutches since he stumbled down a step last month.

"Can you imagine how bad I'd look if I'd actually jumped out of an airplane," he said, alluding to a flawless parachute jump by Bush, 72, over Arizona last month. "I'm looking forward to not being president. You know, if I can jump out of an airplane and look like Gerry Ford does in 30 years I'll be one happy guy."

The remarks tickled both Bush and Ford, two Republicans who joined Clinton at this week's "Presidents' Summit For America's Future" that also brought former President Jimmy Carter for a joint declaration on the importance of community service.
